EmailTemplate.subject: Thanks for joining Flywire at Bursars SFS - now visit our Virtual Booth!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Thank you for attending the Bursars SFS 2020 Virtual Conference! While we miss being face-to-face, PDG did a great job of making sure that we still had an amazing event full of learnings and best practices.
Let's keep the good times rolling! We created a Virtual Booth <[[https://www.flywire.com/industries/education/virtual-booth?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pdg-bursars]]> where you can chat with the Flywire booth staff, view content, attend speaking sessions, and learn more about our Comprehensive Receivables Solution. You can also enter to win a swag pack (we even have hand sanitizer!)
